title: One cull lane fixes or deletes each guard or check with a recorded wrong refusal
why: Owner ruling R5, 15:04 CST Nov 10 ("option e works for now with a revisit maybe to threshold lanes if it turns out to be problematic", relayed by the retrospective session). Owner 15:18 CST: "A is fine -- but the coordinator probably has way more data on how hooks have been acting than your small sample size does" (relayed by the retrospective session).
note: Source: the false alarm lines in docs/debts/notes.md (60 lines, 56 entries, grep on 2026-11-10), plus the coordinator's hook-fire data (15:21 CST): counts are fires, not wrong fires. Feedback inbox 75 (4 wrong: refuses page:496 and page:499 one turn after an ArtifactData read of the item); Recovered guard 39+11 (1 wrong: wants the words git/page/digest); Answered guard 37 (not judged); Past-ruling guard 35 (1 wrong: opus-grant-expires read as settling arbiter Opus grants); Pick guard 35+18 (false alarm on the retrospective session, which talks to the owner itself); context-size notice about 60 from 358k tokens; Report-shape guard 14 (none confirmed); auto-mode refusals 12 (not judged); model-name guard 3; Departs-from guard 2. Retrospective adds three: lane pick guard wrong fire on a coordinator-started session the owner reads (14:4x and 14:58 CST); Departs-from separator guard blocks a missing dash when the meaning is there (low value); Recovered guard forces narration into the owner's report (low value). The cull lane adds each as a notes.md line first. For each guard or check, fix or delete, whichever costs less; the delete gate of rule building-guard-needs-incident is open with the owner (15:21 CST). After the cull, wrong refusals are notes only; revisit threshold lanes only if they become a problem. Record: cull-guard-wrong-refusals (#2568). Restart plan stage 3 step 6 sets when it runs. Added 15:45 CST: review-record guard in lint/report_guard.py reads PASS inside a statistic as a review claim (retrospective session, 15:39 CST); the R10 short-correction line for every blocking Stop refusal (step refusal-ends-short-fix-line). Cull data (retrospective session, 16:29 CST Nov 10, owner asked 16:28 CST): guard scratchpad-owner refused a read-only audit agent writing a scratch copy of a main file over a copy an earlier, finished agent of the same session made. Nothing could be lost. Wrong fire class: the guard does not tell a finished agent's file from a running one's.
